name: Q2
description: The Audi Q2 (2016–present) is the entry-level compact crossover, sitting below the Q3. Built on the MQB-A platform, it offers quattro AWD and the SQ2 performance variant with a 300 hp 2.0-litre TFSI — the most powerful production Audi in its segment.
